sections.name: Cover Page / Issuer Identity
sections.description: Basic issuer identity details appearing on the prospectus cover: registered name, CIN, registered office, contact particulars, promoters, and issue mechanics (lead manager, registrar, price band).

fields.label: Company Name
fields.tooltip: Exact registered name of the company

fields.label: Former Name(s) (if applicable)
fields.tooltip: Prior registered name(s) per RoC/CIN history, e.g. '(Formerly X Private Limited)'

fields.label: CIN (Corporate Identification Number)
fields.tooltip: 21-digit Corporate Identification Number (auto-extracted from Incorporation Certificate)

fields.label: Date of Incorporation
fields.tooltip: Date the company was officially incorporated (auto-extracted from Incorporation Certificate)

fields.label: Registered Office Address
fields.tooltip: Official address registered with ROC. All statutory correspondence is served here.

fields.label: Company Type
fields.tooltip: Legal form of the company as classified by RoC

fields.label: Company Secretary / Compliance Officer Name
fields.tooltip: Named contact person on the cover page for investor correspondence

fields.label: Contact Email
fields.tooltip: Compliance officer email printed on the cover page

fields.label: Contact Telephone
fields.tooltip: Compliance officer telephone printed on the cover page

fields.label: Company Website
fields.tooltip: Corporate website URL — business decision, cannot be extracted from any statutory document

fields.label: Promoter Names (Cover Page List)
fields.tooltip: Names of all promoters as they appear on the cover page banner (SEBI ICDR Sch VI Part A). Overlaps with the detailed 'promoters' list in the Promoters section — keep both in sync.

fields.label: Company Acronym/Abbreviation
fields.tooltip: Short name used for the company throughout the document, e.g. 'XYZ'

fields.label: Lead Manager Name
fields.tooltip: SEBI-registered Category I Merchant Banker (BRLM) appointed to manage the issue

fields.label: Registrar to the Issue
fields.tooltip: SEBI-registered registrar to maintain share records and process applications

fields.label: Total Issue Size (₹ Crores)
fields.tooltip: Total size of the IPO issue in INR Crores (fresh issue + OFS). Overlaps with fresh_issue_size_cr + ofs_size_cr in Offer Details — reconcile the two.

fields.label: Price Band (₹)
fields.tooltip: Price band range, e.g., '100 - 105'

fields.label: Risks in Relation to the First Offer (Text)
fields.tooltip: Standard SEBI ICDR boilerplate, editable. Falls back to regulation-standard wording if left blank — never blocks generation.

fields.label: General Risk (Text)
fields.tooltip: Standard SEBI ICDR boilerplate, editable. Falls back to regulation-standard wording if left blank — never blocks generation.

fields.label: Company's / Selling Shareholders' Absolute Responsibility (Text)
fields.tooltip: Standard SEBI ICDR boilerplate, editable. The banner title adjusts automatically based on whether selling shareholders exist; falls back to regulation-standard wording if left blank.

fields.label: Listing (Text)
fields.tooltip: Standard SEBI ICDR boilerplate, editable. Falls back to regulation-standard wording if left blank — never blocks generation.

sections.name: Offer Details
sections.description: Structure of the fresh issue and offer for sale, face value, selling shareholders, and any pre-IPO placement.

fields.label: Fresh Issue Size (₹ Crores)
fields.tooltip: Business decision — target fresh issue size. Cannot be extracted from any document; set by the company/BRLM.

fields.label: Offer for Sale Size (₹ Crores)
fields.tooltip: Business decision — aggregate OFS size, if any. Company does not receive OFS proceeds.

fields.label: Face Value per Share (₹)
fields.tooltip: Face value of each equity share per MOA/AOA, typically ₹10

fields.label: Selling Shareholders
fields.tooltip: SEBI ICDR Sch VI — Offer for Sale details: name, type, number of shares offered, and CA-certified WACA per share

fields.label: Pre-IPO Placement Amount (₹ Crores)
fields.tooltip: Business decision — proposed Pre-IPO placement size, if any (max 20% of Fresh Issue). Not extractable from any document.

fields.label: Pre-IPO Placement Terms
fields.tooltip: Business/legal decision — pricing basis and conditions of the Pre-IPO placement, if undertaken. Requires banker sign-off.

sections.name: Definitions & abbreviations
sections.description: Standard terms and acronyms used in the draft prospectus.

sections.name: Risk factors
sections.description: Internal and external factors that could impact business operations and profitability, including derived concentration metrics.

fields.label: Internal Risk Factors
fields.tooltip: Describe company-specific risks like key customer dependency, outstanding litigations, promoter background

fields.label: External Risk Factors
fields.tooltip: Describe external risks like raw material inflation, regulatory changes, or competition

fields.label: Top-5 Customer Concentration (%)
fields.tooltip: Derived from top5_customer_revenue_table ÷ revenue_from_operations. Not directly entered.

fields.label: Geographic Concentration (%)
fields.tooltip: Derived from key_geographies_served revenue share, where disclosed.

fields.label: Raw Material Cost as % of Revenue
fields.tooltip: Derived from restated financials (cost of materials consumed ÷ revenue from operations).

fields.label: Consolidated Risk Factor Narrative
fields.tooltip: Manual/LLM-assisted draft of the top-10 risk factors narrative — must be banker-reviewed before filing, per SEBI ICDR Sch VI Part A.

sections.name: Summary of the offer
sections.description: A high-level summary of the business, financial position, and the proposed issue size.

fields.label: Summary Business Note
fields.tooltip: A brief, one-paragraph summary of business operations

sections.name: General information
sections.description: Statutory auditor details verified from documents.

fields.label: Statutory Auditor Name
fields.tooltip: Name of the auditor firm

fields.label: Auditor Registration/Membership No.
fields.tooltip: ICAI membership number

sections.name: Capital structure
sections.description: Authorized, issued, and paid-up capital of the company before and after the IPO.

fields.label: Authorized Share Capital (₹)
fields.tooltip: Maximum share capital company is authorized to issue

fields.label: Pre-Issue Paid-up Capital (₹)
fields.tooltip: Total capital paid by shareholders pre-IPO

fields.label: Pre-Issue Promoter Shareholding (%)
fields.tooltip: Percentage of share capital held by promoters before IPO

sections.name: Objects of the issue
sections.description: Detailed utilization of the IPO proceeds, broken down by use, with the General Corporate Purposes cap validated against Gross Proceeds.

fields.label: Capital Expenditure/Expansion (₹ Crores)
fields.tooltip: Funding allocated for machinery, plants, or expansion

fields.label: Working Capital Requirement (₹ Crores)
fields.tooltip: Funding allocated for working capital

fields.label: Debt Repayment Amount (₹ Crores)
fields.tooltip: Funding allocated to pay off borrowings

fields.label: Issue Expenses (₹ Crores)
fields.tooltip: Lead manager fees, marketing, legal, and printing expenses

fields.label: Use of Proceeds (Itemized)
fields.tooltip: SEBI ICDR Reg 230 — full itemized breakdown of Net Proceeds deployment. Business decision, cannot be extracted.

fields.label: General Corporate Purposes (₹ Crores)
fields.tooltip: Funding allocated for miscellaneous corporate expenses. Same figure as gcp_amount_cr below — kept as one field.

fields.label: GCP Amount — Validated (≤25% of Gross Proceeds)
fields.tooltip: SEBI ICDR Reg 230(2) — General Corporate Purposes must not exceed 25% of Gross Proceeds of the Fresh Issue. Duplicates general_corp_amount; retained separately here to carry the validation flag distinctly from the raw entered amount.

sections.name: Business overview
sections.description: Complete breakdown of products, services, operating model, customers, geographies, facilities, and competitive strengths/strategies.

fields.label: Products & Services Description
fields.tooltip: SEBI ICDR Reg 248(2) — Detailed description of products/services offered. Overlaps with legacy 'products_services' field — reconcile.

fields.label: Industries Served
fields.tooltip: Sectors/industries the company's customers belong to

fields.label: Typical Customers
fields.tooltip: Description of the typical customer profile served. Overlaps with legacy 'key_customers' field — reconcile.

fields.label: Segment Reporting Applicable (Ind AS 108)
fields.tooltip: Whether the company reports separate operating segments under Ind AS 108

fields.label: Segment Reporting Note
fields.tooltip: Explanation if no separate segment reporting applies, e.g. 'single reportable segment'

fields.label: Key Geographies Served
fields.tooltip: Primary states/regions/countries generating revenue

fields.label: Top-5 Customer Revenue Concentration (3-Year)
fields.tooltip: SEBI ICDR — revenue concentration among top customers over 3 fiscal years

fields.label: Manufacturing/Facility Locations
fields.tooltip: List of manufacturing units/branch offices, each tagged Manufacturing Unit / Branch Office / Other — 'None, non-manufacturing entity' is valid for NBFCs/services businesses

fields.label: Business Strengths
fields.tooltip: Competitive strengths narrative — a positioning/marketing judgment call, cannot be extracted from any document

fields.label: Business Strategies
fields.tooltip: Forward-looking strategy narrative — a business/board decision, cannot be extracted from any document

fields.label: Main Products & Services Offered (Legacy)
fields.tooltip: Legacy field retained for backward compatibility — superseded by products_services_description

fields.label: Business Model Description
fields.tooltip: How the business makes money, sales channels, etc.

fields.label: Key Customers/Industries Served (Legacy)
fields.tooltip: Legacy field retained for backward compatibility — superseded by typical_customers/industries_served

sections.name: Industry overview
sections.description: Market trends, industry size, and potential growth of the business segment, sourced from an independent industry report.

fields.label: Industry/Sector Name
fields.tooltip: E.g., Speciality Chemicals, IT Services

fields.label: Industry Report Source
fields.tooltip: Name of the CRISIL/CARE/ICRA (or similar) report commissioned and cited — a commercial/legal decision, not extractable

fields.label: Industry Market Size
fields.tooltip: Best-effort extraction from the industry report PDF — formats vary widely across CRISIL/CARE/ICRA reports; confidence flagged low

fields.label: Industry CAGR (%)
fields.tooltip: Best-effort extraction from the industry report PDF; confidence flagged low due to inconsistent report formats

fields.label: Industry Growth Narrative
fields.tooltip: Narrative synthesis of industry trends — requires judgment beyond raw report extraction

fields.label: Industry Narrative Summary (Legacy)
fields.tooltip: Legacy field retained for backward compatibility — superseded by industry_growth_narrative

sections.name: Promoters
sections.description: Detailed promoter profiles: designation, DIN, tenure, qualifications, and experience.

fields.label: Promoters (Detailed)
fields.tooltip: SEBI ICDR Sch VI Part A — full promoter profiles. Note: a company may have no identifiable promoter (professionally managed) per Reg 2(1)(pp) — in that case this list is empty and 'promoter_names' on the cover page should state so explicitly.

fields.label: Promoter Names (Legacy, Comma-Separated)
fields.tooltip: Legacy field retained for backward compatibility — superseded by the 'promoters' list above

fields.label: Key Promoter Experience Summary (Legacy)
fields.tooltip: Legacy field retained for backward compatibility — superseded by biography_narrative within the 'promoters' list

sections.name: Board of Directors & KMP
sections.description: Board of Directors and Key Managerial Personnel, sourced from DIR-12 filings/board resolutions.

fields.label: Board of Directors
fields.tooltip: Companies Act 2013 Sec 149 — full Board (minimum 3 for public company, including 1 independent director)

fields.label: Key Managerial Personnel
fields.tooltip: SEBI ICDR Sch VI Part A — CFO, Company Secretary and other KMP not already listed as Executive Directors

fields.label: Board Directors Names (Legacy, Comma-Separated)
fields.tooltip: Legacy field retained for backward compatibility — superseded by the 'directors' list above

sections.name: Related party transactions
sections.description: Transactions with subsidiaries, promoters, relatives, or director-controlled entities.

fields.label: Related Party Transactions Declared
fields.tooltip: Details of sales, loans, or purchases with related parties over last 3 years

sections.name: Financial statements (restated)
sections.description: Restated financial performance metrics for the past 3 fiscal years, sourced primarily from restated audited financial statements.

fields.label: Financial Years Included
fields.tooltip: E.g., FY24, FY25, FY26 (auto-extracted from Financial Statements)

fields.label: Equity Share Capital (₹ Cr, 3yr)
fields.tooltip: Restated equity share capital across 3 fiscal years

fields.label: Net Worth (₹ Cr, 3yr)
fields.tooltip: SEBI ICDR Reg 229(2) — latest audited net worth, 3-year restated

fields.label: Revenue from Operations (₹ Cr, 3yr)
fields.tooltip: 3-year restated revenue from operations. Overlaps with legacy revenue_fy24/fy23/fy22 single-year fields in coverage.py.

fields.label: EBITDA (₹ Cr, 3yr)
fields.tooltip: SEBI ICDR Reg 229(1)(b) — EBITDA operating profit track record, 3-year restated

fields.label: Profit After Tax (₹ Cr, 3yr)
fields.tooltip: 3-year restated Profit After Tax. Overlaps with legacy pat_fy24/fy23/fy22 single-year fields in coverage.py.

fields.label: Basic EPS (₹, 3yr)
fields.tooltip: Restated basic earnings per equity share, 3-year

fields.label: Diluted EPS (₹, 3yr)
fields.tooltip: Restated diluted earnings per equity share, 3-year

fields.label: Return on Net Worth (%, 3yr)
fields.tooltip: PAT ÷ Net Worth, 3-year restated

fields.label: Net Asset Value per Share (₹, 3yr)
fields.tooltip: Net Worth ÷ number of equity shares outstanding, 3-year restated

fields.label: Total Borrowings (₹ Cr, 3yr)
fields.tooltip: SEBI ICDR Sch VI Part B — 3-year restated total borrowings. Overlaps with legacy 'borrowings_latest' single-year field.

fields.label: Trade Receivables (₹ Cr, 3yr)
fields.tooltip: Restated balance sheet — trade receivables / sundry debtors, 3-year

fields.label: Net Cash from Operating Activities (₹ Cr, 3yr)
fields.tooltip: Restated cash flow statement — operating activities, 3-year

fields.label: Net Cash from Investing Activities (₹ Cr, 3yr)
fields.tooltip: Restated cash flow statement — investing activities, 3-year

fields.label: Net Cash from Financing Activities (₹ Cr, 3yr)
fields.tooltip: Restated cash flow statement — financing activities, 3-year

fields.label: Auditor Qualifications
fields.tooltip: Any reservations, qualifications, or adverse remarks by statutory auditors on the restated financials. Defaults to 'None' — flagged if left empty rather than explicitly confirmed.

fields.label: Latest Year Revenue (₹ Crores) (Legacy)
fields.tooltip: Legacy single-year field — superseded by revenue_from_operations table

fields.label: Latest Year Profit After Tax (₹ Crores) (Legacy)
fields.tooltip: Legacy single-year field — superseded by pat table

fields.label: Total Borrowings (₹ Crores) (Legacy)
fields.tooltip: Legacy single-year field — superseded by total_borrowings table

sections.name: Key Performance Indicators
sections.description: Sector-specific KPIs matching the company's industry template (Manufacturing / NBFC / Jewellery & Trading / Services), tracked across 3 fiscal years.

fields.label: KPI Sector Template
fields.tooltip: Business classification decision — determines which KPI field set applies. Sector-dependent by design; do not hardcode a single universal KPI list.

fields.label: KPI Values (3-Year, by Selected Sector)
fields.tooltip: Values populated against the field set matching kpi_sector. See kpi_sector_templates for the per-sector KPI list.

sections.name: Shareholding Pattern
sections.description: Pre- and post-offer shareholding of promoters, promoter group, and top shareholders, plus ESOP details.

fields.label: Pre-Offer Shareholding
fields.tooltip: SEBI ICDR — full pre-offer cap table by shareholder

fields.label: Post-Offer Shareholding
fields.tooltip: Derived once offer size and price band are finalized — cannot be computed until fresh_issue_size_cr and price_band are set

fields.label: Promoter Group Members
fields.tooltip: SEBI ICDR Reg 2(1)(pp) — immediate relatives and entities forming the Promoter Group

fields.label: ESOP Details
fields.tooltip: Scheme reference and vesting schedule for any Employee Stock Option Plan — 'No ESOP scheme in force' is a valid entry

sections.name: Weighted Average Cost of Acquisition (WACA)
sections.description: CA-certified weighted average cost of acquisition for promoters and selling shareholders.

fields.label: WACA Table

item_fields.label: WACA of Shares Acquired in Last 1 Year (₹)

fields.tooltip: Must originate from a dated Chartered Accountant certificate — cannot be auto-generated or estimated

fields.label: WACA CA Certificate Date
fields.tooltip: Date of the Chartered Accountant certificate the WACA table is drawn from. Must reference an actual, dated certificate — do not auto-generate this.

sections.name: Legal & regulatory disclosures
sections.description: Pending litigations, criminal proceedings, regulatory actions, and statutory tax disputes.

fields.label: Litigations against Company (Legacy Narrative)
fields.tooltip: Legacy free-text field — superseded by the structured litigation_summary table

fields.label: Litigations against Promoters (Legacy Narrative)
fields.tooltip: Legacy free-text field — superseded by the structured litigation_summary table

fields.label: Summary of Outstanding Litigation
fields.tooltip: Must originate from legal counsel via a structured litigation schedule upload, not free-text scraping or inference. Every cell in this table is manual-only even though it renders as structured data.

sections.name: Statutory compliance certificates
sections.description: Statutory identification numbers and registrations verified from documents.

fields.label: GSTIN (GST Number)
fields.tooltip: Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (auto-extracted from GST Certificate)

fields.label: PAN (Permanent Account Number)
fields.tooltip: Company PAN Card Number

fields.label: Name on PAN Card
fields.tooltip: Exact legal name as registered on PAN

fields.label: GST Declared Annual Turnover (₹ Crores)
fields.tooltip: Annual turnover registered in GST filings (auto-extracted from GST Certificate)

sections.name: Material contracts & documents for inspection
sections.description: List of critical supplier/customer agreements, MOA/AOA, and other inspectable files.

fields.label: Description of Material Contracts
fields.tooltip: Brief description of key commercial contracts, underwriting agreements, or leases

sections.name: Declaration
sections.description: Directors' official declaration and signature certifying the prospectus validity.

fields.label: Declaration Signed Status
fields.tooltip: Confirm directors have agreed to the standard declaration

Jewellery & Trading.kpi_name: Ratio of Sales through Retained Customers
